author: claude
summary: Added D2's crop UI for non-square voice icon uploads, and fixed a real pre-existing bug found while verifying it live: GET /api/voices/{id}/icon never existed, so every icon had 404'd since C5 originally shipped. Confirmed PNG (not JPG) is the correct, spec-compliant icon format -- corrects an earlier PARTIAL review verdict that took a stale TASKS.md/PR-checklist wording ('1:1 JPG processing') at face value instead of checking the real spec first.

files.change: Added GET /{voice_id}/icon (find_secure_file-contained, 404 if voice or icon missing, serves the saved icon.png). This route never existed -- only the upload POST did.
New component. Drag-to-reposition + zoom-slider crop UI over a fixed square viewport; canvas-crops to a 512x512 PNG File on Apply. No external cropper dependency.

Square images still upload directly (unchanged fast path). Non-square images now open IconCropModal instead of round-tripping to the server for a 422. Falls back to a direct upload attempt (surfacing the server's own error) if the client-side dimension probe itself fails.
spec_version 1.5.1 -> 1.6.0. Documents the GET route fix and the crop-UI addition; confirms PNG remains the correct icon format.
voice-bundles.md version bumped to 1.6.0 in the spec index.

tests_added: tests/api/test_api_voices_metadata.py::TestVoiceIcon -- 6 cases: square-upload-then-download round-trip (revert-checked red on pre-fix code), non-square rejected 422, unsupported content-type rejected 422, upload/download against an unknown voice 404, download before any upload 404.

frontend/tests/unit/components/metadata/IconUpload.test.tsx -- square uploads directly (no crop modal), non-square opens the crop modal instead of uploading, dimension-probe failure falls back to direct upload, server error message surfaced verbatim.

frontend/tests/unit/components/metadata/IconCropModal.test.tsx -- renders dialog, produces a square PNG File via canvas on Apply once the image has loaded, Apply/zoom disabled until image loads, Cancel button and Escape both call onCancel.
verified_live: Confirmed end to end in the running app: uploaded a real non-square 400x300 PNG through the actual Edit Metadata modal, cropped it via the new modal, POST returned 200, and the uploaded icon then rendered correctly via the newly-added GET route (previously 404).
